h1: Norefjell ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Norefjell is the nearest real mountain to Oslo: fifteen lifts, 30 runs and two terrain parks, under two hours from the capital, with the slopes dropping towards Lake Krodern.
stayOverview: Norefjell is a day mountain for Oslo as much as a week's destination. The beds at the base are ski-in; Noresund by the lake is the cheaper alternative.
hotelIntro: Book against high season, and remember that weekend crowds come up from Oslo in under two hours.
rentalCars: A car is the normal way here: Norefjell is under two hours from Oslo and there is no railway to the mountain.
